text:
sai: Heads-up — nightly perf job flagged an unexpected KV-cache eviction spike on ded-3 that coincides with a latency bump. Captured a trace but artifact size is huge (~1.2GB).
perf-bot: nightly-kv-eviction-capture ran at 2026-03-17T03:12:00Z. Artifact: s3://redwood-perf/kv_eviction/2160001111/nsys.tar.gz :rotating_light:
amelia: can you paste the root nsys timeline snippet? curious if it's a single big kernel or lots of small ones.
juan: quick snippet from the nsys summary: ```GPU activities: 95s total, top kernels: fused_mha: 41.2s (43%), kv_read: 18.3s (19%), kv_evict: 12.7s (13%), memcpyHtoD: 6.5s (7%)```
kyra: fused_mha being 43% is suspicious — we recently changed kernel selection heuristics for head dim=128. Could be falling back to slower path under eviction pressure.
sai: artifact size makes CI storage costly. Proposal: capture only a 30s window around detected eviction spikes and include perfetto markers to trim. Also tag with seq_len/bs/eviction_rate metadata. Thoughts?
amelia: agree on targeted window. Also set sampling rate to 10% for heavy runs to avoid blowing budget. We can do deterministic triggers: start capture when kv_evict rate > threshold.
ops-bot: suggested job config snippet: ```yaml
jobs:
  nightly-kv-watch:
    triggers:
      - eviction_rate > 0.02
    capture_window_sec: 30
    perf_tools: [nsys, perfetto]
    labels: [seq_len, batch_size, model_variant]
    upload_path: s3://redwood-perf/kv_eviction/{{ts}}/
```
juan: I'll add a small wrapper that starts nsys + perfetto with perfetto markers around the eviction kernel so we can prune artifacts to ~50-100MB. Will push a PR with job changes and the marker hooks.
kyra: also include kernel-name annotation in the metadata (kernel_selector_version=X). That helps diff dashboards detect kernel-path regressions.
sai: perfect. Can we also add an automated diff job that compares the last 7 days of eviction traces for the same model_variant and flags >10% increase in fused_mha time?
amelia: yes — I can extend the diff dashboard logic to include 'kernel-time per call' and 'eviction-rate' metrics. It should post a short alert into #incidents if thresholds breach.
juan: PR created: https://git.redwood/infra/ci/-/merge_requests/4825 Add kv-watch capture + markers. Testing on staging now.
sai: assigning review to @amelia and @kyra. Please prioritize — want this in nightly within 48h if staging looks good. :thumbsup:
amelia: on it, will review this afternoon.
kyra: will validate kernel labels and run a quick compare against last week's runs.
perf-bot: run-summary: staging run (2160001205) -> captured 32s window, artifact 68MB, top kernel delta: fused_mha +9% vs baseline. link: s3://redwood-perf/kv_eviction/2160001205/report.html
sai: thanks — moving to follow-up board, tagging @oncall-eng-runtime to watch overnight.
juan: noted, I'll add a cleanup job to prune any artifacts older than 30 days unless ticketed.
amelia: tiny follow-up: please include sequence length histogram in the upload; it's critical for normalizing kernel time.
kyra: and include GPU utilization heatmap so we can rule out throttling.
sai: awesome — closing the loop here. If the diff alerts fire overnight we'll triage. Thanks everyone.
